title: Decision Queue Entry
description: A question or decision request in .agent/questions.jsonl. Agent writes when hitting uncertainty; operator answers asynchronously.

task.description: Task ID this question relates to. Task is blocked while status is 'pending'.

question.description: The question, written clearly enough for async review without session context.

context.description: Brief background: what the agent was doing, what it discovered, why it's stuck.

options.description: Concrete choices. If provided, operator can pick one or write free-text.

default.description: Agent's recommended option. Used for auto-resolve after trust calibration.

impact.description: What depends on this decision. Helps operator prioritize.

status.description: pending = awaiting operator. answered = operator responded. auto-resolved = system applied default after trust threshold met.

answered.description: When the operator answered. Null while pending.

answer.description: Operator's answer. Free text or one of the options.
